name: Qualisys Holding Aktiebolag
summary: Qualisys Holding AB (publ), a Göteborg, Sweden-based company founded in 1989, provides sophisticated motion capture and 3D positioning tracking solutions across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the United States, and the Asia-Pacific region. Their comprehensive product portfolio features a range of specialized cameras, including the Aryus, Miqus (video, hybrid), Arqus MRI, and underwater models. For data processing and integration, they offer the Qualisys Track Manager, which handles 3D data from their cameras and other system-integrated accessories. Additionally, the company develops QTM Connect software for real-time data streaming to platforms like Unreal, Unity, Maya, and MotionBuilder, facilitating the transfer of skeletal, 3D marker, rigid body, gaze vector, and analog data. Other software tools include the Project Automation Framework for creating analysis-enabled QTM projects and a real-time SDK. Qualisys also delivers focused analysis products for applications such as online reporting, baseball, cycling, functional assessment, gait, golf, and running. These advanced systems are utilized across numerous fields, including human and animal biomechanics, sports and medical research (e.g., MRI, equine lameness), sound and motion studies, automotive, OEM, robotics, marine, wind power, virtual reality, and animation/VFX. The company operates as a subsidiary of Vätterledens Invest AB.
